assets.label: San Diego monkeyflower
assets.taxonomy_note: Coastal southern California native shrub. Name Diplacus puniceus retained; some listings use Diplacus aurantiacus var. puniceus.
assets.seasonal_behavior: Spring red-orange flared tubular flowers; dry summer foliage thinning/dormancy may occur with water stress. Rain/irrigation and coastal/inland exposure alter timing.

world_scale.basis: illustrative managed specimen; designer approval pending

wind_attachment_metadata.constraint: Root/stem base fixed, outer stems/leaf tips subtle motion; pot fixed. Metadata only, no simulation.

generation.prompt_exact:
Create an actual production sprite sheet of FOUR isolated Southern California garden plants in detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART. Visible square pixel clusters, stepped diagonal contours, deliberately limited restrained organic palette, precise pixel shading, no soft painterly gradients or 3D render. Think each object authored on a fine 192-to-256-pixel logical grid and shown with nearest-neighbor crispness. Warm upper-left light, subtle selective dark contour, three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility. Botanical structure is carefully detailed; quiet garden objects support birds as focus, no birds/animals here. No UI or text.

TRUE transparent alpha background. Exactly 2 by 2 separated grid, one full plant per quadrant. Each silhouette occupies at most 74 percent of its quadrant width and 76 percent height, with broad fully empty gutters and transparent margins on ALL sides. All leaves, roots and flower tips fully visible. No overlap. No labels, panels, borders, checkerboard, backdrop, pots, ground tiles, large shadows. Small natural ground contact collar and only a few tiny pebbles. Fit specimens independently to their cells; cell size is not physical scale comparison. No duplication of species.

UPPER LEFT — San Diego/red bush monkeyflower, Diplacus puniceus: a loose low rounded woody subshrub with narrow dark-green opposite lanceolate leaves, slender brown woody base, dark orange-red TUBULAR flowers that flare into two-lipped five-lobed open faces. Natural sparse flowers around stem tips, not fuchsia tubes, not trumpet vine. Healthy spring flowering state.
UPPER RIGHT — San Diego sunflower, Bahiopsis laciniata (also called Viguiera laciniata): compact upright branching woody shrub, many relatively narrow lance-shaped resinous green leaves with lightly irregular or toothed margins, several small yellow daisy heads with yellow-to-brown centers and short yellow rays. Native shrub proportions; not tall crop sunflower, not broad diamond-leaf Encelia californica. Healthy flowering state.
LOWER LEFT — Coyote brush, Baccharis pilularis: dense but naturally irregular rounded woody green shrub, numerous SMALL glossy obovate green leaves, subtle small teeth on some leaves, visible brown basal branch forks. Healthy evergreen foliage ONLY, no flowers or cottony seed fluff; plant sex/cultivar unresolved. Not a conifer, no broad giant leaves.
LOWER RIGHT — Common yarrow, Achillea millefolium: low basal mound of very fine feathery deeply divided green leaves; slim upright leafy stems support several FLAT TOPPED clusters of tiny ivory-white daisy florets, a delicate white flowering perennial clump. Not Queen Anne's lace rounded lacy umbels and not fernleaf yarrow yellow flowers. Healthy white-flowering phenotype, no cultivar identity implied.

Deliver crisp pixel-art whole sprites, not photographs or smooth illustrations. Transparent cutouts only. Each plant is a flattened whole sprite; no internal branches/foliage layer separability implied.

generation.prompt_exact:
Create a matching alternate STATIC STATE sprite sheet using the supplied four-plant pixel-art sheet as style, camera, lighting, species, plant order and general silhouette reference. Keep precise crisp naturalistic pixel-grid art and restrained palette. This is a dry/spent foliage illustration set, NOT animation frames, NOT exact pixel-aligned morphs. Maintain each plant's recognizable woody form and botanical distinctions. Real transparent alpha background, exactly four separate full sprites in a 2 by 2 grid, generous empty gutters and at least 8 percent transparent margin inside every quadrant. No text, labels, panels, animals, birds, ground tiles, painted backdrop or checkerboard. Each rooted plant has only its modest contact pebbles/collar.

UPPER LEFT same Diplacus puniceus San Diego monkeyflower: DRY SUMMER/WATER-STRESS state. Remove the red-orange flowers; preserve woody branching structure with considerably sparser narrow green-gray and a few curled tan leaves. Natural partial summer dormancy, not dead black sticks. Some living green leaf tips remain. No flames or dramatic drought cracks.
UPPER RIGHT same Bahiopsis laciniata San Diego sunflower: DRIER LATE-GROWING-SEASON state. Fewer narrow green leaves, modest tan lower leaves, a few small brown spent flower heads on fine stems, one or two faded yellow rays only. Still a living native woody shrub. Not all brown and not orange autumn broadleaf foliage. Water-dependent thinning; no claim every plant follows same calendar.
LOWER LEFT same Baccharis pilularis coyote brush: MILD DRY-STRESS evergreen state. Keep the rounded dense small-leaf green structure and basal branches; outer foliage somewhat duller olive, scattered sparse gaps and a few tan older interior leaves. NO flowers or cottony seed fluff because individual sex unresolved. No deciduous bare crown and no whole-crown orange fall.
LOWER RIGHT same Achillea millefolium yarrow: SPENT FLOWER state after bloom. Replace white flower corymbs with small flat-topped buff-brown seedhead clusters and slender tan stems. Keep the fine deeply divided feathery basal foliage partly green with some dry tan leaf tips. No yellow flowering cultivar; no snowy white flowers. Living perennial regrowth retained.

All tips and ground contact fully inside frame. Preserve consistent detailed pixel-art scale and light from upper left. Do not make separate seasons into four unrelated new species. Each plant remains one flattened whole RGBA sprite; no separable layers/rig/animation claimed.

derivatives.operation: Rectangular crop only; RGBA byte values unchanged.

generation.prompt_exact:
Create an actual production sprite sheet of FOUR isolated managed nursery plants, each in its own modest container, in detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART. Visible square pixel clusters, stepped diagonal contours, deliberately limited restrained organic palette, precise pixel shading, no soft painterly gradients or 3D render. Think each object authored on a fine 192-to-256-pixel logical grid and shown with nearest-neighbor crispness.
